As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE ROLE Trustly is looking for a motivated and experienced regulatory compliance professional to support the development and day-to-day running of SlimPay's regulatory compliance programme in Paris. SlimPay operates as a licensed payment institution providing account-to-account and recurring payment services across Europe, which places us squarely within a fast-moving and heavily regulated industry. This role is responsible for helping SlimPay hold the right licences, meet its regulatory obligations in every market where it operates, and move efficiently into new markets as they open. Reporting to the EU/UK Chief Compliance Officer, you will: - Support the CCO in executing SlimPay's regulatory compliance strategy - Help obtain and maintain the licences and authorisations required to support the business - Provide second-line oversight over the key processes on which SlimPay relies, including the mapping of licences to products - Help provide SlimPay's Board and Management Team with the reporting, advice, and assurance they need to exercise effective oversight of compliance operations (three-lines-of-defence model) WHAT YOU’LL DO CORE REGULATORY MANAGEMENT - Horizon Scanning, Obligations and Advocacy: Conduct horizon scanning, report analysis to stakeholders and the Board. You will own API and Partner Integrations end to end: its architecture, its reliability, its operation in production, and where it goes next. You'll own our API-based connectivity: direct bank APIs (FDX), core and online banking provider APIs, and third-party aggregators. Within your first year, you'll help hire and lead the team that owns it with you. What you'll do - Own the architecture, service contracts and production health of API and Partner Integrations. - Own the operation of your services: on-call, SLAs, incident response and root-cause fixes. There is no separate operations team; the team that builds the service runs it. - Meet the observability standards set for every service, and make the service measurably better each quarter. - Use AI tools to understand existing code quickly, then turn what you learn into design docs, interface definitions and runbooks that engineers and AI agents can work from. - Partner with the engineers who run these systems today, across the Americas and Europe, to transfer knowledge. - Direct AI-assisted implementation: write and close implementation plans, review output against requirements, and own integration testing. - Help hire and shape the team that will own this domain. The team plays a critical role in protecting both consumers and merchants by ensuring regulatory compliance, managing financial crime risks, and supporting secure and seamless payment experiences across our platform. About the role Driven by rapid growth and a commitment to operational excellence, Trustly is seeking a KYC Analyst to join our Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function. You will work cross-functionally to support complex KYC workflows, transaction monitoring investigations, sanctions and PEP escalations, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews. The role requires strong analytical capability, sound risk judgment, and the ability to navigate fast-paced operational environments while maintaining high regulatory standards. This role leads fraud detection and response in Risk Operations, from finding emerging fraud patterns to stopping them with short-term rules.
